title: The Midnight Leak
paras: At a small lakeside research centre, Amira raised young fish for a study of water temperature. The lake provided [[ideal|ideal]] conditions because its water stayed cool through summer. She kept her records in [[alphabetical|alphabetical]] order by species. One night, an alarm warned her that a fish tank was losing water.

Amira lived beside the centre. Still wearing her [[nightgown|nightgown]], she pulled on boots and hurried outside. Water covered the floor, but she could not see its source. She placed a [[bucket|bucket]] beneath the tank's lowest pipe, then called Tomas, who looked after the equipment.

Tomas dried the pipe and spread white chalk [[powder|powder]] underneath it. Within seconds, falling drops left dark spots in the chalk. Directly above them was a narrow [[gap|gap]] where two pipes joined. While Tomas repaired it, Amira needed fresh lake water. Her years of [[rowing|rowing]] helped: she took the centre's boat beyond the muddy shore and filled several containers.

By sunrise, the tank was full and the fish were swimming normally. Amira whispered a prayer of [[thanksgiving|thanksgiving]]. A visiting [[politician|politician]] later suggested giving her a [[medal|medal]] for saving the valuable fish. She laughed and asked for a spare water pump instead. A week later, it arrived, ready for the next emergency.
zh: 在一座湖边的小型研究中心，阿米拉养着一批幼鱼，用于研究水温。湖水整个夏天都保持凉爽，提供了理想的条件。她按照鱼类名称的字母顺序整理研究记录。一天夜里，警报响起，提醒她一个鱼缸正在漏水。
阿米拉就住在研究中心旁边。她还穿着睡裙，套上靴子便匆匆跑了出去。地板上到处是水，她却看不出水从哪里漏出来。她在鱼缸最下面的管子下放了一个桶，然后打电话给负责维护设备的托马斯。
托马斯擦干管子，在下面撒了一层白色粉笔粉末。几秒钟后，落下的水滴就在粉末上留下了深色斑点。斑点正上方的两根管子连接处有一道细小的缝隙。托马斯修补管子时，阿米拉需要去取新鲜的湖水。她多年的划船经验派上了用场：她划着研究中心的小船驶离泥泞的岸边，装满了几个容器。
日出时，鱼缸已经装满水，鱼儿也在正常游动。阿米拉轻声祷告，表达感恩之情。后来，一位来访的政治家提议给她颁发奖牌，表彰她救下了这些珍贵的鱼。她笑了，表示宁愿要一台备用水泵。一周后，水泵送到了，可以随时应对下一次紧急情况。

q.s: The lake was suitable for Amira's research because it remained cool during the summer.
q.why: 首段说明湖水夏季保持凉爽，条件理想。

q.s: Amira took off her nightgown before hurrying outside.
q.why: 第二段明确说她仍穿着睡裙就赶了出去。

q.s: The visiting politician paid for the spare water pump.
q.why: 文章只说水泵送到了，未说明由谁付款。
